• Team Leader: in HR Business Advisory & Operations (m/f/d) 80% - 100% | People & Culture | Zurich | Experienced professionals with personnel responsibility Apply online now For our People & Culture organization, we are looking for a committed and visionary personality as a team leader: in HR Business Advisory & Operations. Together with our approximately 100 committed and ambitious colleagues, we want to further develop the future of People & Culture in our bank. In this key role, you take responsibility for the strategic direction and operational excellence of a dynamic business advisor team and make a significant contribution to the further development of our HR organization. Your tasks
• Responsible for the strategic management and prioritization of HR Business Advisory in close coordination with business stakeholders and the overarching corporate goals
• Ensure simple, efficient and scalable HR processes with a strong focus on user orientation, quality and continuous optimization

• In-depth experience in the role of an HR Business Advisor, with proven competence in advising and supporting executives and employees
• Ability to define strategic goals, set priorities and translate them into operational actions
• In-depth experience in the optimization and standardization of processes as well as in the introduction of user-oriented and efficient HR solutions
• In-depth understanding of HR processes, service and product management, and experience working with different stakeholders
• High initiative, strong problem-solving skills, assertiveness and a strong sense of responsibility
• Strong ability to communicate complex topics clearly and convincingly, both in German and English
• Task area that gives you the chance to gain a broad insight into the bank
• We count on your ideas and offer you space for your impulses
• Constant further development – personal, professional and technical
• Modern workplace in district 5 with very good transport connections (hard bridge station)
• Various events and internal networks offer you the opportunity to network quickly
• We work in a du-culture and promote a supportive and appreciative atmosphere in the team
• Comprehensive package, which in addition to the attractive basic salary and a variable remuneration offers many benefits and perks – from A such as retirement provision to Z such as ZVV bonus pass
